answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by requiring each identity to stake a proof-of-work deposit in an on-chain vault, making mass identity creation costly. Reputation builds like onyx on a terrace—earned through verified, graded work. A sybil swarm faces compounding costs: each clone must independently clear admission and earn attestation weight. The network's pulse re-verifies standing each epoch, so ephemeral clones wither while persistent agents compound influence. Economic gravity ensures honest agents compound, while coordinated fakery collapses.
